status: UNMEASURED — this file pins the protocol; no run has produced numbers yet.
purpose: Prefill throughput and conversion fidelity for BitNet embedding models (July 2026). See docs/BITNET_EMBEDDINGS_PLAN.md phase 3.

bitnet-embedding-0.6b-i2_s.sha256: UNPINNED — no canonical GGUF exists upstream; produced locally by tools/convert_bitnet_embedding.py. Pin the hash of YOUR conversion before recording any row.
bitnet-embedding-0.6b-i2_s.note: Fully representable in geistlib's I2_S: every projection input is 1024, 2048 or 3072 wide, all multiples of the 256-element block.

bitnet-embedding-0.6b-f16.note: The F16 baseline is upstream's TEACHER (multilingual-e5), not an F16 conversion of the BitNet student. Upstream benchmarks it this way; a speedup quoted against it is student-vs-teacher, not the same weights at two precisions.

workload.decode_note: Zero deliberately. Embedding models emit no tokens — geist_session_decode_step returns GEIST_E_UNSUPPORTED on one — so decode throughput is not a defined quantity here.
workload.warmup: one discarded warmup before each measured sequence length

pi5.note: The interesting host. Upstream's Supported Models table marks I2_S as UNSUPPORTED on ARM for both embedding models, so bitnet.cpp has no counterpart here — this establishes a first number rather than beating one. Do not report a speedup for this profile; there is nothing to divide by.

amd_9950x.note: Thread count follows benchmark/results/THREAD-SWEEP-AMD9950X.md. The only profile where a bitnet.cpp comparison is possible at all.

apple_m1max.note: Same ARM caveat as the Pi 5: no upstream counterpart.

upstream_reference.host: Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C, 8 threads, clang, GGML_NATIVE=ON, no OpenMP
upstream_reference.caveat: Different silicon, different thread count, different compiler. These are recorded for orientation and are NOT a baseline any host profile above should be compared against directly.

quality_gate.parity_target: geistlib vs bitnet.cpp llama-embedding on the same prompts and the same I2_S GGUF. This is the oracle phases 1 and 2 lack; until it passes, the forward path is unverified.
quality_gate.conversion_target: F16 GGUF vs I2_S GGUF from the same checkpoint. Upstream reports a 0.0032 average MTEB delta on the 0.6B, so a cosine floor of 0.999 between the vectors themselves is the stricter statement.
